Dear Dr. Lindgren,

The ethics committee met on October 27 and approved the amended protocol without further changes. Enrollment may resume immediately, and the cap remains at 180 participants across the four sites.

Please ask each site coordinator to file the updated consent form in REDCap before enrolling anyone new. Ms. Halvorsen in our office can help with the upload if needed.

Sincerely,
Thomas Agyeman
